quickSummary: Direct nitration of aniline with HNO₃/H₂SO₄ at 288 K yields 51% para, 47% META, and 2% ortho product because strongly acidic medium protonates aniline into the Anilinium ion (Ph-NH₃⁺), a powerful -I/-M meta-director. Sulfonation yields Sulfanilic acid, which exists as a dipolar Zwitterion (⁺H₃N-C₆H₄-SO₃⁻). Aniline FAILS Friedel-Crafts reactions due to AlCl₃ complexation.
summary: Master the anilinium meta-nitration mechanism, sulfanilic acid zwitterion structure, and Friedel-Crafts inhibition.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
THE ANILINIUM META-NITRATION MECHANISM
                    
   In strongly acidic medium ($\text{H}_2\text{SO}_4$), basic aniline undergoes protonation:
   $$\text{Ph-NH}_2 + \text{H}^+ \rightleftharpoons \mathbf{\text{Ph-NH}_3^+ \text{ (Anilinium Ion)}}$$
   The **Anilinium Ion ($\text{Ph-NH}_3^+$)** carries a positive charge on Nitrogen, making it a strong
   **$-I / -M$ Meta-Director**, directing incoming $\text{NO}_2^+$ to the *meta* position ($47\%$)!

Product Yields: 51% p-Nitroaniline + 47% m-Nitroaniline + 2% o-Nitroaniline
conceptBreakdown.content: Direct nitration produces $47\%$ $m$-nitroaniline because the strongly acidic $	ext{H}_2	ext{SO}_4$ protonates the basic amino group to $	ext{Ph-NH}_3^+$, which deactivates the ring and directs substitution to the meta position.

conceptBreakdown.codeSnippet:
SULFANILIC ACID ZWITTERION & FRIEDEL-CRAFTS INHIBITION:

• Sulfonation: Ph-NH₂ + H₂SO₄ ──[453–473 K]──► H₂N-C₆H₄-SO₃H ⇋ ⁺H₃N-C₆H₄-SO₃⁻ (Zwitterion)
• Friedel-Crafts Failure: Ph-NH₂ + AlCl₃ ──► Ph-NH₂⁺-AlCl₃⁻ (Deactivating Complex; FAILS FC!)
conceptBreakdown.content: Sulfanilic acid exists as an internal dipolar Zwitterion ($^+	ext{H}_3	ext{N-C}_6	ext{H}_4	ext{-SO}_3^-$). Aniline fails Friedel-Crafts alkylation/acylation because the lone pair on $-	ext{NH}_2$ binds the Lewis acid catalyst $	ext{AlCl}_3$, forming a strongly deactivating complex.
